title: Privacy Policy
meta_description: How Chimwemwe Driving School2 collects and uses your information.
body:
## Information we collect

When you book a lesson through our contact form, we collect your **name, email, phone number, and course preference** so we can schedule and confirm your lessons.

## How we use it

We use your details only to:

- Contact you about bookings and lesson scheduling
- Send reminders about upcoming lessons or test dates
- Improve our courses based on feedback

We do not sell or share your information with third parties for marketing purposes.

## Contact us

If you have questions about your data, email us at hello@chimwemwedriving.mw.
